headline: Scheduled publishers now preserve derived truth, while a routed production Worker mismatch remains explicitly held.

items.title: Publisher cascade drift removed at the source
items.insight: Four scheduled-publication paths now rebuild the proof and narrative artifacts derived from every feed they commit, eliminating the clean-pull red state reproduced at session start.
items.evidence: build:check 220/220 at S291 closeout · uptime/refresh-live-data/vault-narrative cascade repairs

items.title: Transitive publisher coverage became a blocking contract
items.insight: A permanent transitive-closure gate now rejects any scheduled publisher that stages a source feed without rebuilding and staging its byte-checked consumers.

items.title: The routed Worker outage gained a precise production signature
items.insight: The production telemetry outage was traced to an out-of-band Worker replacement: source expects OPTIONS /v/rum 204 while the routed production path returns Pages fallback 405.

items.title: Incident pressure remained visible without fabricated green
items.insight: The 47.6 percent strict uptime signal remained visible as a forcing function; no history was reset and no source-only security claim was substituted for routed runtime evidence.
items.evidence: S291 SIL 998/1000 · uptime history retained · production promotion hold retained

items.title: Semantic stability replaced timestamp-only churn
items.insight: Ship receipts stopped rewriting timestamps when their semantic content was unchanged, reducing scheduled commit churn without weakening freshness or drift detection.

items.title: Portfolio sitemap repair traveled through the ownership-safe path
items.insight: The static-route sitemap checker correction moved through signed Studio Ark cargo, preserving repository ownership while sharing the portfolio-wide fix.
items.evidence: S291 LATEST_HANDOFF Ark receipt · no sibling tree writes

followUps: Restore the production Worker only after the explicit auth/security promotion hold is cleared or accepted.
Separate site-content availability from strict full-stack continuity without rewriting incident history.
Bind the next staging candidate to a critical-artifact manifest in addition to its build SHA.
blockers: Production Worker deployment remains founder-gated by the fail-closed identity and Supabase promotion hold.
Supabase management, SQL migration, Edge Function authority, and a real-provider identity ceremony remain unavailable.
